name: checkbox-tree
title: Checkbox Tree
blurb: Headless hierarchical checkbox component with parent/child state sync.
description: Render-prop-based tree checkbox component. Manages nested checkbox state with parent-child synchronization: checking a parent checks all children; partially-checked parents show indeterminate state. Supports default-checked nodes.
use_when: Category filters, permission trees, or hierarchical selections with automatic parent-child sync.
avoid_when: Simple flat lists—the overhead of tree management isn't worth it.
a11y: Fully headless; accessibility depends on renderNode implementation. Built with basic node/label assumptions.

props.name: renderNode
props.type: (props: {node: TreeNode; isChecked: boolean | "indeterminate"; onCheckedChange: () => void; children: React.ReactNode;}) => React.ReactNode
